free_tier.stated: no free plan: Simple pricing is $10 a year with no hard limits on users, custom domains or storage; a trial account starts with a limited credit balance and needs an SMS-capable phone
free_tier.notes: Advanced pricing bills resources instead: storage $0.56 per compressed GB per year, a $4.00 yearly account fee, $0.23 per 1000 external sends plus $0.18 per GB, $0.03 per 1000 received plus $0.04 per GB, and no charge for custom domains or users on owned domains. Significant overuse of Simple pricing may require a switch to Advanced pricing.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no maximum message or attachment size is stated on the captured pages

retention.stated: no hard storage limit on Simple pricing; storage on Advanced pricing costs $0.56 per compressed GB per year

egress.terms: not applicable: a mailbox; external sending is rate limited to approximately 3000 messages per day, or 300 at once, per account

interface_detail: IMAP at imap.purelymail.com (993, SSL/TLS), SMTP at smtp.purelymail.com (465 SSL/TLS, or 587 with STARTTLS), POP3 at pop3.purelymail.com (995), ManageSieve at mailserver.purelymail.com (4190); WebDAV, CardDAV and CalDAV for basic file storage, contacts and calendars
tooling: any IMAP, POP3 or SMTP client; IMAP IDLE; Sieve filters over ManageSieve or in webmail
chaining: a flat $10 a year for unlimited mailboxes on unlimited owned domains, with external sending capped near 3000 messages per day; a fit for many addresses on domains already owned.

limits.value: approximately 3000 external messages per day, or 300 at once, per account
very low external sending limits on trial accounts

binding_note: Simple pricing sets no hard limit on users, domains or storage, so the external sending rate is the first stated ceiling.

identity_cost.detail: the paid signup charges $10 through Stripe; the free trial needs an SMS-capable phone to activate. Signup asks for an administrator username on a shared domain and a password, with a recovery email or phone recommended.

reliability_note: an account broken into and used to send spam is locked
confidence_note: prices and limits read from the vendor pages; imap.purelymail.com:993 accepted a TCP connection and smtp.purelymail.com:587 answered with an SMTP banner; no login or send was made
